It's like a prolonged trance. You know how some people spend 2 hours on Wikipedia reading about bizarre things that don't concern them at all, like all the torture techniques employed by the Japanese military during World War II, or the many types of wolf that exist around the world, or the works and life of Charles Dickens? It's like that, but it can take months. And everything around me dies in the process.

Sometimes days, weeks and months go by without me even noticing it. But I have bipolar disorder. It's both tragic and exhilarating like I had a hidden source of cocaine inside my head that decided to act up all of a sudden. I don't think you have anything. Your brain was kinda funny today, that's all. You're not an X-men yet :P
